turns.learner: Hello! I need English for daily life here. Can we practise irregular past verbs?
turns.tutor:
You already know that a finished event needs a past form, like "yesterday" or "last week".

Worked example, thinking aloud: "Last week I (drive) to work." Step 1: "last week" is finished, so I need the past. Step 2: "drive" is irregular, so I do not add -ed. Step 3: the past form is "drove". Result: "Last week I drove to work."

Now a partly solved one: "Yesterday she (take) a bus to the office." Step 1 is done: "yesterday" is finished, so I need the past. Your step: write the full sentence with the past form of "take".
